name: Phosphor
description: A terminal IRC client on warm green phosphor: a timestamped log with a nick column, directory-tree channels, a `$ who` nick list, a block-caret input line, box-drawn panes, a soft glow and a tube that warms up. Pings in amber; pictures dithered in phosphor greens.

cursor blinks at the VT220 rate
